set.body: Add first estimator products over the core algebra: SVD/PCA returning BiProjection; PLSC and CCA returning CrossProjection; typed ComponentScale and diagnostics instead of overloaded metadata fields. Add solver capabilities for SVD, symmetric eigen, generalized eigen, and pseudo-inverse, with shared deterministic tests and JVM extension points. Acceptance: dense fixtures match multivarious/neuroimaging reference behavior within tolerance; sparse-centered PCA projects without densifying preprocessing; all estimator results are inspectable typed artifacts, not estimator-specific map subclasses.
set.title: Multivar decompositions: SVD/PCA, PLSC, and CCA MVP
